headline: On last trading session, Sensex and Nifty closed higher in a weekly wrap led by Trent and Reliance.

marketStatus.message: Market is closed today because it is a weekend. It will reopen on Monday, 2 November.

why: Government released an additional tax devolution tranche of ₹1.09 lakh crore to states in October.
Early trading sessions saw strong buying support in Reliance along with foreign capital inflows.
Trent led the weekly rally as SENSEX and NIFTY50 advanced 2% while NIFTY Smallcap 100 jumped 4%.
SEBI chairman confirmed that the market regulator is keeping a close watch on Tata Group developments.
whatHappening: In weekly performance, Sensex and Nifty rose 2% with strong gains in broader market indices.
Adani Ports surged 4% as Sensex posted a 600-point jump during recent trading.
Market volatility picked up with India VIX rising while crude oil remained above $116.
Deutsche Bank flagged risks to the US dollar amid an AI-driven global equity selloff.
summary: On the last trading day, Indian benchmark indices recorded a weekly gain of 2%, driven by strong foreign inflows and heavy buying in Reliance. Trent led the broader market rally as the Nifty Smallcap 100 index jumped 4%. Today, 1 November 2026, the market is closed for the weekend and will reopen on Monday, 2 November.
